p: thou goest out to battle against: Meaning, upon just occasion: for God does not permit his people to fight every time it seems good to them.
goeth with you: Is present to defend you with his grace and power.
dedicated it: For when they first entered to dwell in a house, they gave thanks to God, acknowledging that they had that benefit by his grace.
eaten of it: The Hebrew word signifies to make common or profane, Le 19:25
nations: For God had appointed the Canaanites to be destroyed, and made the Israelites the executers of his will, De 7:1.
tree of the field is man's: Some read: For man shall be instead of the tree of the field, to come out in the siege against you.
